evidence_stage: v101.9 — robustness fix: background convenience features (scroll-position memory via visibilitychange, update-checking via pageshow/visibilitychange) now run inside a safeRun() guard, so a failure inside them is logged and swallowed instead of crashing the whole app. This is a direct response to a reported iPad Safari crash when tapping Share/Add-to-Home-Screen, which showed the browser's own sanitized 'Script error.' message with no further detail obtainable (a known WebKit behavior in this context, not something our error handler can unmask). No corpus/speech change.
